name: Akshay's Kindle Packages
description: Combined repo for all of Akshay's Kindle packages — dropbear-ssh, sysmon, and anything added later. Each package's own README/source lives in its own repo (linked below); this manifest just aggregates them into one add-repo URL. dropbear.nealing.net and sysmon.nealing.net still work as add-repo URLs too — they redirect here.

dropbear-ssh.name: Dropbear SSH
dropbear-ssh.author: Akshay
dropbear-ssh.description: On-demand SSH/SFTP server (dropbear, repackaged from notmarek/kindle-usbnetlite) over your existing WiFi — no USB networking needed. A random password is generated on install and printed in the KPM log; set your own any time by editing /mnt/us/usbnetlite/etc/ssh_password and restarting the server. Verified working end-to-end (install, launch, real SSH session, survives upgrade/downgrade) on Kindle PaperWhite 4, kernel 4.1.x. Source: https://github.com/akshaylahudkar/dropbear-ssh

sysmon.name: System Monitor
sysmon.author: Akshay
sysmon.description: Live-updating battery, memory, storage, CPU and jailbreak/tools status — battery health via real capacity retention and cycle count (not just charge %), RAM and CPU load, /mnt/us storage usage, uptime, SoC temperature, and which jailbreak + tools (KPM, kterm, KOReader, KindleForge) are present. Refreshes every 4 seconds for up to ~20 minutes per launch via a background loop, no server required. Confirmed working on a Kindle PaperWhite 4. Source: https://github.com/akshaylahudkar/sysmon
